decision: Stop the palette follow-up at its declared final4k endpoints; no extension or promotion. Keep V43 as the working reference. Neither continuation establishes a photo PSNR gain over V95. Both worsen tested color tails; the wider palette mitigates the control high-noise color regression but does not repair V95 overall. No convincing new native GFX/detail gain.
next_quality_target: Address valid-source color/low-noise regression tails while retaining the recovered weak-detail response, using V43 architecture and quality-first review. Lower-noise diagnostic remains a separate bounded study; no speed work.
scope: Complete fixed seven-stage development review, one training seed. Source/scene bootstrap does not estimate training-seed uncertainty. All18 native groups actually viewed; real AHD/separate ISO100 references are not exact GT. Analytic scalar replay has small recorded nonexact differences from the older study, with all differences preserved. No SOTA, broad unknown-scene RawNIND superiority, V95/V96/V97 full100MP or ten-second qualification.
